title: OpenAI acquires AI travel platform, Expedia and Booking shares fall - Investing.com

status.text: OpenAI's Nov 10 acquisition of Odessia, terms undisclosed, folded in founder Francis Davidson; the standalone travel app has since closed to new users, with existing-booking customers redirected to email support.
status.text_ja: OpenAIは11月10日、オデッシアを条件非公開で買収、創業者デビッドソン氏も合流。単体アプリは新規受付を停止し、既存利用者はメール窓口へ案内されている。

background.headline: Sonder founder Francis Davidson launches AI travel agent Odessia with $6M Sequoia-led seed
background.summary: Francis Davidson, the former co-founder and CEO of Sonder, launched the AI travel-planning startup Odessia in June 2026 after raising about $6 million in seed funding led by Sequoia Capital.
background.summary_ja: ソンダーの共同創業者で元CEOのフランシス・デビッドソン氏は2026年6月、AI旅行代理サービス「Odessia」を立ち上げ、セコイア・キャピタル主導で約600万ドルのシード資金を調達した。

background.headline: OpenAI buys AI consultancy Tomoro to anchor new $4bn deployment business
background.summary: OpenAI acquired Tomoro, an AI consulting and engineering firm whose roughly 150 staff had built Virgin Atlantic's AI concierge, to anchor a new AI deployment business backed by more than $4 billion.
background.summary_ja: オープンAIはAIコンサルティング企業Tomoroを買収した。同社の約150人の人員はバージン・アトランティック航空のAIコンシェルジュを手がけており、40億ドル超を投じる新たなAI導入事業の中核を担う。

background.headline: OpenAI scales back ChatGPT in-app checkout plans, Expedia and Booking shares jump
background.summary: A report said OpenAI was scaling back plans to let users complete travel purchases directly inside ChatGPT, directing checkout to partner apps instead; Expedia and Booking Holdings shares rose sharply on the news.
background.summary_ja: OpenAIがChatGPT内での直接決済機能の計画を縮小し、決済は提携アプリ側に委ねる方針だと報じられ、エクスペディアとブッキング・ホールディングスの株価が急伸した。

background.headline: Sonder files for Chapter 7 bankruptcy after Marriott ends licensing deal
background.summary: Sonder, the short-term rental company Francis Davidson co-founded, shut down operations and moved to file for Chapter 7 bankruptcy after Marriott terminated their licensing agreement, citing Sonder's default.
background.summary_ja: フランシス・デビッドソン氏が共同創業した短期賃貸企業ソンダーは、マリオットがライセンス契約を解除したのを受けて事業を停止し、連邦破産法7条の適用を申請する方針を示した。

since.headline: Odessia's standalone travel app closes to new users after OpenAI deal, existing bookings routed to support
since.summary: Following OpenAI's acquisition announcement, Odessia stopped offering its AI trip-planning app to new users and directed customers with existing bookings or saved plans to email support for help, consistent with the deal being described as an acqui-hire of the team rather than a continuation of the standalone product.
since.summary_ja: OpenAIによる買収発表を受け、オデッシアは単体サービスとしての新規受付を停止し、既存の予約や旅行計画がある利用者にはスポート宛への桥対応を案内した。単独事業の繼続ではなく、チームの引き纙が目的であることを示す動きとなった。

since.headline: OpenAI confirms Odessia acquisition; founder Francis Davidson joins to work on travel
since.summary: OpenAI acquired AI travel-planning startup Odessia and brought on its founder, Francis Davidson, to work on travel at OpenAI; the companies did not disclose financial terms, and Odessia's standalone service was discontinued.
since.summary_ja: OpenAIはAI旅行計画スタートアップのOdessiaを買収し、創業者のフランシス・デビッドソン氏がOpenAIで旅行分野を担当することになった。両社は財務条件を公表せず、Odessiaの単独サービスは終了した。

since.headline: Expedia, Booking Holdings and Airbnb shares fall intraday on OpenAI's Odessia purchase
since.summary: Shares of Expedia, Booking Holdings and Airbnb fell intraday after reports that OpenAI had bought Odessia, with Expedia trading as low as $245.31 versus a $259.16 open on the day.
since.summary_ja: OpenAIによるOdessia買収報道を受け、エクスペディア、ブッキング・ホールディングス、エアビーアンドビーの株価が日中に下落した。エクスペディア株は同日の始値259.16ドルに対し一時245.31ドルまで下げた。

since.headline: Odessia deal described as acqui-hire of nine-person team five months after Sequoia-backed seed
since.summary: Coverage characterized OpenAI's purchase of Odessia as an acqui-hire of its roughly nine-person team, coming about five months after Sequoia Capital backed the startup's seed round.
since.summary_ja: OpenAIによるOdessia買収は、セコイア・キャピタルがシード資金を支援してから約5か月後に行われた、約9人規模のチームの実質的な引き抜きだと報じられている。

since.headline: Report ties part of Expedia's drop to analyst price-target cuts and a weak broader market
since.summary: Investing.com reported that Expedia's decline that day reflected both the OpenAI-Odessia news and a separate round of analyst price-target cuts, on a day the Nasdaq also fell more than 1% after a higher-than-expected inflation reading.
since.summary_ja: Investing.comによると、同日のエクスペディア株下落はOpenAIによるOdessia買収報道に加え、別のアナリストによる目標株価引き下げも一因で、ナスダック総合指数も予想を上回るインフレ指標を受けて1%超下落していた。
